note: What a server sends, in pairs, to rebuild a client's world without a new connection: the first marks what the client holds, the second deletes whatever is still marked. The header carries zero.

bits.name: stage
bits.note: 0 to mark every unit, and every object kept until a checkpoint other than an inhibitor, also clearing floating text, any screen tint and the state of neutral camps; any other value to delete whatever is still marked.
